correctness.rationale: Exact transition generator checked from labeled updates; unique closed communicating count class excludes the transient corner. Exact stationary means follow a two-equation linear system. Generator bound E D²≤(h+h²)/3 synchronizes class proportions. After T=2mn/(m+n) acceleration, drift θ−x and bracket x(1−x) give a Jacobi polynomial moment recursion, uniquely identifying Beta(2θ,2(1−θ)) on [0,1]. The standalone package checker passes 709 finite comparisons; asymptotic validity is mathematical, not inferred from finite data.

value.rationale: The location of opposite fixed opinions in degree-inequivalent vertex classes is physically natural and creates a sharp stationary change from a uniform balanced limit to a skew beta law. The complete distribution, nonvanishing variance θ(1−θ)/3, and exact finite means are not routine renamings of complete-graph laws and offer a solvable benchmark for heterogeneous cooperative dynamics.
